headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 3, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers took a thrilling 10-9 win over the Tampa Bay Rays, led by Dillon Dingler's 4-hit, 2-home run performance. The Miami Marlins secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Heriberto Hernández leading the offense. The Kansas City Royals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-2 victory, while the Minnesota Twins took down the Chicago White Sox 9-6.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jonathan Heasley, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list for the Tampa Bay Rays. Braden Shewmake and Carlos Correa are also out for the Houston Astros, while Brooks Kriske, Ramón Laureano, Nick Pivetta, Welinton Herrera, and Robert Garcia are on the injured list for their respective teams.

The Minnesota Twins made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez, while the Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Thrilling 10-9 Win Over Rays**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Tampa Bay Rays in a high-scoring matchup, securing a 10-9 victory. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with a 4-hit, 2-home run performance, driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Heriberto Hernández leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Sandy Alcantara earned the win for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Reds 9-2**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-2 victory. Lane Thomas led the Royals' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down White Sox 9-6**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 6-9 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Joe Ryan earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 4 earned runs. Miguel Vargas led the White Sox offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Jonathan Heasley Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Jonathan Heasley has been placed on the 15-day injured list, retroactive to May 29, 2026.

top_news.title: **Twins Acquire Justin Lawrence in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Justin Lawrence in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, who received cash in return.
